# Average speed

<!-- STEP id="speed" -->
**Average speed** = total distance travelled / time interval.

The athlete ran 160 m in 16 s, so her average speed was 160 m / 16 s = 10 m/s. Like distance, average speed has no direction.

<!-- STEP id="unit" -->
Its unit is metre per second, m/s. Speeds are also given in kilometre per hour, km/h.
